full.name: act
full.description: Generic entry point: run one legal action by name with its args.

full.name: activate_item
full.description: Activate an owned item (books, lottery tickets, scanners).

full.name: advance_dialogue
full.description: Advance the current non-choice dialogue line. Re-read get_state afterwards.

full.name: advance_expedition
full.description: Advance an ongoing expedition one step.

full.name: analyze_item
full.description: Run an analyzer on a target and return its visible result fields.

full.name: answer_prompt
full.description: Answer exactly one option of the modal read by get_pending_prompt (routed by kind/target to the native callback; never a guessed button index). choice is 'confirm' or 'cancel'. Success requires prompt_closed:true plus the post-answer state (incl. shop_state), so 'the panel closed' and 'the confirmed action happened' stay separate facts. Unknown/ambiguous modal => prompt_ambiguous (never clicked); a changed modal => prompt_changed with dispatched:false; a disabled option => choice_unavailable. Destructive confirmations default to 'cancel' unless you understand the consequence; always read get_pending_prompt first and re-read state afterwards.

full.name: arrest_wanted
full.description: Report/arrest a wanted person by id.

full.name: bargain
full.description: One bargain offer: direction is sell_discount|sell_markup|buy_markup|buy_discount; percent is 10|25|50|75.

full.name: bargain_preview
full.description: Preview one bargain: success/leave/refuse chance, price before/after, reputation estimate.

full.name: barter_accept
full.description: Accept the current client's barter offer when acceptable.

full.name: barter_status
full.description: Current client's barter offer and conditions.

full.name: blur_new_game_option
full.description: Trigger one native pointer-exit on the currently hovered perk card; this does not change the selection. Use it after focus_new_game_selected_perk returns hover_conflict (for example a same-id available card kept the hover). Single step; re-read get_new_game_options afterwards.

full.name: buy_upgrade
full.description: Buy a network upgrade by id (also unlocks supplier phone contacts).

full.name: buy_wholesale
full.description: Buy the current client's whole wholesale offer (requires isOfferWholesale).

full.name: call
full.description: Open the phone and dial a contact.

full.name: call_next_customer
full.description: Call the next customer to the counter. Re-read get_state afterwards.

full.name: capture_screenshot
full.description: Capture the current game frame as evidence (JPEG, short side 768) and return its path relative to ModData/pawnmind/screenshots/. Use it right before stopping on a hard failure, or when the screen disagrees with what the bridge reports. Server-side throttling applies; returns screenshot_unavailable when capture is off.

full.name: choose_dialogue
full.description: Pick a dialogue choice by index (0-based). Re-read get_state afterwards.

full.name: close_windows
full.description: Close the note/book/contract/deed panels, hide floating windows, and dismiss the two adapter-less overlays (tutorial control-hint overlay; dialogue/typewriter settings dialog) through their own native buttons, so the shop is visible again. Use it right after read_book/read_item/analyze_item and before ending the day; 'closed' may contain 'overlays'. Returns what was closed and what (if anything) is still open. One shot: if the screen is still dirty it reports window_readback_mismatch and you must stop, not retry; never fall back to press.

full.name: commissary_buy
full.description: Buy one item from the supply station (commissary) by identifier.

full.name: confirm_new_game
full.description: Grant exactly one native new-game write permission for the dedicated recording slot. Recording is locked by default; requires an armed bindable slot. The native Start triggers the game's InitialSave (a real disk write); when the first-run confirm prompt is visible, this op also clicks its native yes once. It does not retry or pick a slot. Re-read get_recording_save_status and get_new_game_options afterwards.

full.name: confirm_trade
full.description: Buy (side=buy) or sell (side=sell) one item currently on the back counter.

full.name: contraband_status
full.description: Owned contraband/stolen items with levels and risk flags.

full.name: deliver_request
full.description: Deliver a fillable StoreRequest and claim rewards.

full.name: dismiss_current_client
full.description: Send the current client away through the game's own dismissal path. Escape hatch for a client you cannot serve (for example a seller who arrived with nothing on the table, so there is no trade to accept): while a client is present, call_next_customer and end_day both refuse. Refused with dialogue_active while a dialogue is running (finish it with advance_dialogue first).

full.name: dismiss_tutorial_hints
full.description: Hide the tutorial hint bubbles only: turns PlayerStore.tutorialEnable off once, closes the visible hints and hides the tutorial group. It does not unlock services, skip the intro, or change items, story clients, toggles or endless mode. Requires rev. Returns changed/tutorial_enabled/hints_hidden; re-read get_state.tutorial_hints afterwards. A tutorial_hints_readback_mismatch means stop, do not retry.

full.name: dispatch_expedition
full.description: Send a hireling to an unlocked expedition location.

full.name: end_call
full.description: End the current phone call.

full.name: end_day
full.description: Close the shop for the day. Refused with cannot_end_day while an important client (the landlord) is queued, and with customers_waiting when ordinary customers are still queued: the game asks before throwing them out, so pass dismiss_waiting=true only when you deliberately give up on them. Re-read get_state afterwards.

full.name: events_status
full.description: Active and queued store events.

full.name: expedition_status
full.description: Expedition unlock, locations, hirelings and ongoing runs.

full.name: focus_new_game_selected_perk
full.description: Move native focus/hover onto one already-selected perk; this does not select or unselect it. Re-read get_new_game_options afterwards. Fails closed if the bridge cannot focus that card.

full.name: get_action_history
full.description: Recent actions with their args, ok flag and revision.

full.name: get_calendar
full.description: Read the store calendar for the next `days` days (default 7, max 14; it may cross the week boundary). Each day lists the active/queued events for that day plus `rent_due`; `rent` gives the next rent day, the amount and whether it falls in the current week. Day numbers come from the live day counter, not from guesses. Read-only, no rev. Use it at the start of a run to plan around rent day, inspections and threats.

full.name: get_clientele
full.description: What kind of customers the display case attracts: showcase types, the discerning-shopper chance and cooldown, the predicted (client, chance %, item) rows shown by the clientele panel, and the number of random normal customers. Read-only, no rev. Use it to decide what to put in the showcase and whether to expect a rich buyer before opening. The reading is cached for the rest of the game day (cached=true), so repeated calls return the same snapshot instead of re-rolling the game's RNG.

full.name: get_day_report
full.description: Read this morning's report lines: power/electricity, insurance, security, storefront cleaning, rent warnings and the after-hours "opened late, missed a customer" line. Read-only, no rev. Call it after waking up (after sleep + wait_for_events) before deciding the day. `source` says which path was used: structured night_logs, the visible morning panel, or the bridge cache. `readable:false` with `reason:"morning_pending"` means the async day transition has not finished; wait for the day to change and read again instead of sleeping twice.

full.name: get_item
full.description: Full visible details for one item id: container, value, count, lock, size, descriptions.

full.name: get_layout
full.description: Return the grid layout (width/height, rows of item ids) and item positions for a container.

full.name: get_legal_actions
full.description: Return the actions that are legal right now (state-derived, includes args) plus candidate_actions. legal_actions rows were accepted by the native guards; candidate actions (availability=unknown, requires=native_guard) are plausible but unproven - execute one only through its write tool and treat an unavailable/refused result as normal, not as a bug. Old snapshots without candidate_actions degrade to an empty list.

full.name: get_new_game_options
full.description: Read the current native new-game menu: visible options, current selection, rules and pagination. Read-only; no rev or id.

full.name: get_operation
full.description: Read-only (no rev): two-axis status of one write action, {ok, known, operation_id, op, execution_status, delivery_status, dispatched, error, rev, result_rev}. ok:true only when execution_status=completed. Use it after a lost response or an uncertain/pending write; unknown_operation means the in-process record is gone (mod restart or run change) - re-read get_state instead of replaying with a new action_id.

full.name: get_pending_prompt
full.description: Read the native confirmation modal that currently owns the input, if any: {ok, prompt:{kind, target, body, confirm_text, cancel_text, confirm_enabled, cancel_enabled, single_button, source_op}|null}. kind is 'confirmation' (generic) or 'negotiation_confirm' (negotiation-tablet confirm panel); target names the native window, so answer by identity never by button index. Read-only, no rev. Two modals open at once => prompt_ambiguous. Call it whenever state.prompt is not null or a write returns confirmation_required, and read the text before deciding.

full.name: get_recording_save_status
full.description: Read-only status for the dedicated recording slot. Recording is locked by default. Returns only the configured/bound slot and its binding fingerprint (slot, run id, run number, start type, start scenario); it never lists other slots, previews or paths. No rev; never writes, saves or starts a game.

full.name: get_run_summary
full.description: Compact run summary: day, shop state, cash, rent, inventory, current client.

full.name: get_state
full.description: Return the current shop snapshot: cash, rent, customer and negotiated item. legal_actions contains only actions whose native guards accepted; candidate_actions lists plausible actions that still need a native check (for example bargain directions while the panel is open) and must not be treated as legal.

full.name: get_ui_snapshot
full.description: List active UI controls (tablet buttons and plain buttons) with stable ids.

full.name: go_out
full.description: Leave the shop and travel to a night location.

full.name: health_status
full.description: Player wounds, luck, addiction timers.

full.name: husbandry_status
full.description: Owned animals/fish with health/dead state.

full.name: inspect_ticket
full.description: Inspect one lottery ticket.

full.name: list_analyzers
full.description: List owned analyzers (water strip/aquascan, chem scanner, plant analyzer, gene scanner).

full.name: list_books
full.description: List owned/unlocked books (vanilla BOOK_TAG and paper GUIDE_PAPER_TAG).

full.name: list_contacts
full.description:
List phone contacts, state, cooldown and spend.

        include_hidden only expands contacts the phone book has not shown yet
        when the bridge runs with allow_test_items=true (a debug profile) and
        recording is not armed. Production and recording sessions return
        hidden_contacts_forbidden and stay on the visible contact set.

full.name: list_containers
full.description: List player containers (main/front/back/showcase/hidden/afterhour/trash/sold) with counts.

full.name: list_factions
full.description: Faction reputation amounts, influence and every reputation perk with threshold, unlock state, remaining points and direction (positive thresholds unlock by gaining reputation, negative ones by losing it).

full.name: list_goods
full.description: List goods on the front/back counters: scope=client (non-owned), sellable (owned+client wants), all.

full.name: list_interactions
full.description: List available interactions for one item: activate/toggle/target.

full.name: list_inventory
full.description: Paginated inventory for one container; search matches item name or identifier.

full.name: list_labels
full.description: List editable label categories and conditions for an item.

full.name: list_locations
full.description: List discovered night locations (dumping ground / commissary / Dr Jackson) and availability.

full.name: list_machines
full.description: List owned standard machines with state, progress and slots.

full.name: list_marks
full.description: List marked fish/animals with their color.

full.name: list_requests
full.description: Active customer/faction requests and rewards.

full.name: list_screenshots
full.description: List recent evidence captures, newest first, with total_count/total_bytes/budget_bytes/dropped/budget_exhausted. Read-only.

full.name: list_services
full.description: Nightly services (insurance, janitorial, power, informant) and toggles.

full.name: list_signs
full.description: Owned marketing signs.

full.name: list_tickets
full.description: List owned lottery tickets with number/edition/matches/prize.

full.name: list_upgrades
full.description: List network/store upgrades with cost/unlock/prerequisite state.

full.name: list_wine
full.description: List owned wine containers/bottles and finished state.

full.name: load_game
full.description: Load a save slot from the main menu (slot ids are listed in get_state.save_slots).

full.name: load_recording_game
full.description: Load the bound dedicated recording slot once. Recording is locked by default; only available after that slot is bound, and it can only load the bound slot (no slot parameter). Re-read get_recording_save_status afterwards.

full.name: lottery_status
full.description: Lottery unlock state, edition, day and prize table.

full.name: machine_collect
full.description: Move items from a machine slot back to the backpack.

full.name: machine_grow_status
full.description: Hydroponic grow status: power/water/seed/progress.

full.name: machine_insert
full.description: Insert an inventory item into a machine slot.

full.name: machine_status
full.description: Show one machine's slots and contents.

full.name: memory_bootstrap
full.description: Read-only (no rev): verified, unexpired memories for session start, highest confidence/usage first. Its query is local and safe while the game write gate is locked. scope is the caller's identity (game_version/save_id/run_id/timeline_id); without it only version/global experience is returned, so another run's private facts never leak. Each item has memory_id/kind/text/confidence/why/evidence_count/contradict_count.

full.name: memory_get
full.description: Read-only (no rev): one memory with its evidence events and full revision history. Evidence rows keep event_id, evidence_grade, evidence_role (support/contradict/context) and added_at; when the events DB is configured each row also carries the event metadata. Use it to audit why a rule exists before trusting it.

full.name: memory_retrieve
full.description: Read-only (no rev): recall verified rules for the current situation using FTS5, keywords and declared entities. Hidden statuses (proposed/candidate/conflict/deprecated/superseded), expired rows and other scopes are hard-filtered. state is the current game snapshot (for example {"in_game": true, "rent": {"days_left": 1}}); a conditional rule is never returned when its condition is missing or false. Each item carries recall_reason (fulltext/keyword/entity), evidence_count and contradict_count. token_budget keeps the highest-priority warning and drops the rest.

full.name: memory_status
full.description: Read-only (no rev): counts, status/kind distribution, schema version and file paths for the memories database and the separate events database. If the events DB is not configured or missing the events section degrades to configured=false with a reason instead of failing.

full.name: move_item
full.description: Move one item; omit x/y to auto-place. turns=0..3 rotates 0/90/180/270 degrees.

full.name: new_game
full.description: Start a fresh apprentice run from the main menu. Never touches existing save slots.

full.name: new_game_continue
full.description: Continue one intermediate new-game page. Does not confirm the first-run prompt or press difficulty Start; re-read get_new_game_options afterwards.

full.name: new_game_next_page
full.description: Turn one new-game page: row=available|selected, direction=-1 (previous) or 1 (next). Re-read get_new_game_options afterwards.

full.name: open_new_game_menu
full.description: Open the native new-game menu (one UI step). Re-read get_new_game_options afterwards.

full.name: open_shop
full.description: Open the shop shutter. Re-read get_state afterwards to confirm.

full.name: phone_advance
full.description: Advance the phone dialogue by one step.

full.name: phone_choose
full.description: Choose a phone dialogue option by index.

full.name: phone_state
full.description: Current phone call state and dialogue.

full.name: ping
full.description: Round-trip check used to verify the in-game bridge is alive.

full.name: press
full.description: Invoke a control from the last get_ui_snapshot by id (for windows without a typed adapter).

full.name: read_book
full.description: Read an owned book by item id or book id; returns pages and optionally one page.

full.name: read_item
full.description: Read one item's visible details plus book/document flags.

full.name: redeem_ticket
full.description: Redeem a winning lottery ticket.

full.name: report_client
full.description: Report the current customer (any reportable client; is_wanted tells the risk).

full.name: return_home
full.description: Return from a night location to the shop.

full.name: save_game
full.description: Save the current run. Re-read get_state afterwards; saving is synchronous.

full.name: save_recording_game
full.description: Save once through the native save. Recording is locked by default; this only works after the dedicated recording slot is bound, and it only saves that bound slot (no slot parameter). Re-read get_recording_save_status afterwards.

full.name: scavenge
full.description: Scavenge at the dumping ground; returns gained items and remaining attempts.

full.name: security_status
full.description: Security evidence, crimes, case officer and current inspection item.

full.name: select_new_game_option
full.description: Select one scenario/perk/difficulty card in the open menu (one native click). Re-read get_new_game_options afterwards to verify the actual selection.

full.name: set_label
full.description: Set one editable label condition on an item.

full.name: set_pen_mode
full.description: Set marking pen mode: 0 red, 1 purple, 2 green, 3 blue, 4 orange, 5 eraser.

full.name: sleep
full.description: Sleep into the next morning: settles night services, autosaves and advances the day. Only legal after the shop is CLOSED for the day (call end_day first): otherwise not_closed. It never skips the landlord: cannot_end_day while an important client waits, customers_waiting unless dismiss_waiting=true.

full.name: stage_negotiation_item
full.description: Stage one item on the weighted/back negotiation counter for the current client, through the same native placement path a player drag uses (no direct assignment of currentNegociatedItem, ownership, intent or price). Pre-checks the current client, the item container/ownership, the current staged item, the negotiation UI and revision and refuses with a stable error (dispatched=false) when a trustworthy field is missing (no_client, client_unreadable, item_not_found, item_sold, item_unreachable, not_owned, already_owned, intent_undefined, modal_open, negotiation_unreadable, back_counter_full). Returns staged_item_id_before, staged_item_id_after, negotiation_open and client_identity_unchanged: completed only when staged_item_id_after equals item_id, the item sits on the weighted counter, the tablet is open and the client identity is unchanged. A silent native return or a mismatched readback is uncertain, never ok:true - read get_state.negotiated_item and do not retry the same item with a new action_id (a different item is allowed); confirm_trade is the next step only after completed.

full.name: start_fermentation
full.description: Try to start fermentation on a wine bottle.

full.name: toggle_item
full.description: Toggle an owned item (gene scanner, machine switches).

full.name: toggle_service
full.description: Toggle a nightly service on/off.

full.name: use_tool
full.description: Use an owned tool on a target item (screwdriver, UV, scanner, marking pen).

full.name: wait_for_change
full.description: Block until the shop revision changes (customer arrives, dialogue advances).

full.name: wait_for_events
full.description: Block until the game revision changes; returns the fresh state (long-poll, no busy loop).

full.name: wait_operation
full.description: Read-only (no rev): bounded poll of get_operation for up to timeout_ms (0..10000, default 2000). Returns the terminal operation payload (completed/rejected/failed) or, on timeout, ok:false + status=pending + execution_status + operation_id + next - never a fake success. The poll runs in this Python process; the Unity main thread is not blocked. Do not start a new action id for the same op while it is pending.

full.name: wait_until
full.description: Block until a state condition holds: rev_changed, client_present, client_arrived, can_call_next, dialogue_active, dialogue_choice, shop_open, shop_closed, negotiation_open.

full.name: wanted_status
full.description: Wanted-person visit state and wanted list.

full.name: wine_add_ingredient
full.description: Move a berry/yeast into a wine bottle's ingredient grid.

full.name: wine_add_water
full.description: Add water to a wine bottle (test/gameplay helper).

full.name: wine_status
full.description: Wine bottle fermentation/quality details.
